segments.speaker: Ishita Kapoor
segments.text: Hi team, winter sale ka plan aaj close karna hai, time kam hai.

segments.speaker: Varun Sinha
segments.text: Haan, pichhle saal hum late ho gaye the, competitors pehle hi discount daal chuke the.

segments.speaker: Ishita Kapoor
segments.text: Isliye is baar jaldi start karna hai. Main 4 December soch rahi hoon.

segments.speaker: Rakesh Yadav
segments.text: 4 December ko stock ready hoga? Woollens ka naya consignment abhi raaste mein hai.

segments.speaker: Ishita Kapoor
segments.text: Rakesh, consignment kab tak aa jayega?

segments.speaker: Rakesh Yadav
segments.text: Transporter bol raha hai 30 November tak, ek-do din upar neeche.

segments.speaker: Pallavi Ghosh
segments.text: Toh 4 December safe hai, beech mein teen-chaar din ka buffer hai.

segments.speaker: Ishita Kapoor
segments.text: Theek hai, final: winter sale 4 December se start hogi aur saat din chalegi.

segments.speaker: Varun Sinha
segments.text: सात दिन ठीक है, उससे लंबी sale में लोग बोर हो जाते हैं।

segments.speaker: Ishita Kapoor
segments.text: Ab influencers. Varun, pichhli campaign mein kya result aaya tha?

segments.speaker: Varun Sinha
segments.text: Bade influencers pe aadha budget gaya, par conversion bahut kam tha. Micro wale achhe chale.

segments.speaker: Pallavi Ghosh
segments.text: Haan, chhote creators ki audience zyada trust karti hai, comments bhi genuine the.

segments.speaker: Ishita Kapoor
segments.text: Toh is baar sirf micro influencers ke saath jaayenge, bade naam nahi.

segments.speaker: Varun Sinha
segments.text: Agreed. Main das-baarah micro creators ki list bana leta hoon.

segments.speaker: Rakesh Yadav
segments.text: Ek idea, radio pe ek jingle chala dete hain, local FM pe, sardiyon mein log sunte hain.

segments.speaker: Varun Sinha
segments.text: Radio ka tracking hi nahi hota, pata hi nahi chalega kitni sale usse aayi.

segments.speaker: Ishita Kapoor
segments.text: Haan Rakesh, radio abhi nahi. Woh idea is sale ke liye drop kar dete hain.

segments.speaker: Rakesh Yadav
segments.text: ठीक है, कोई बात नहीं, बस एक सुझाव था।

segments.speaker: Ishita Kapoor
segments.text: Creatives ka kya status hai? Pallavi?

segments.speaker: Pallavi Ghosh
segments.text: Banner ka pehla draft ready hai, par colours abhi final nahi hain. Do options hain.

segments.speaker: Ishita Kapoor
segments.text: Pallavi, saare creatives final karke shukravar tak bhej do, banners aur reels dono.

segments.speaker: Pallavi Ghosh
segments.text: हाँ, शुक्रवार तक सारे creatives भेज दूँगी।

segments.speaker: Rakesh Yadav
segments.text: Waise warehouse ka stock count 28 November ko hai, us din main available nahi rahunga.

segments.speaker: Ishita Kapoor
segments.text: Theek hai, stock count wala alag schedule hai, creatives se uska lena dena nahi.

segments.speaker: Varun Sinha
segments.text: Ad budget ka split bhi chahiye, kitna search pe, kitna social pe.

segments.speaker: Ishita Kapoor
segments.text: Varun, tum channel wise split bana do, mujhe numbers ke saath chahiye.

segments.speaker: Varun Sinha
segments.text: Haan, main channel wise split bana ke sheet share karta hoon.

segments.speaker: Pallavi Ghosh
segments.text: Email campaign bhi chalega na? Hamari mailing list mein bahut saare bounce aate hain.

segments.speaker: Varun Sinha
segments.text: Haan, pichhli baar pachchis percent bounce tha, sender score kharab ho raha hai.

segments.speaker: Ishita Kapoor
segments.text: Toh email list saaf karni padegi pehle. Team dekh legi, jo bhi free ho.

segments.speaker: Rakesh Yadav
segments.text: Mere team mein koi email tool nahi samajhta, main nahi le paunga.

segments.speaker: Ishita Kapoor
segments.text: Koi baat nahi, team mein se koi kar lega, bas sale se pehle email list clean honi chahiye.

segments.speaker: Pallavi Ghosh
segments.text: Discount kitna rakhenge? Flat ya slab?

segments.speaker: Ishita Kapoor
segments.text: Slab rakhte hain, pehle bhi wahi chala tha. Exact numbers finance ke saath baat karke.

segments.speaker: Varun Sinha
segments.text: Free shipping ka threshold bhi neeche karein? Abhi 999 hai.

segments.speaker: Ishita Kapoor
segments.text: Woh finance ke saath discuss karungi, aaj decide nahi kar sakte.

segments.speaker: Rakesh Yadav
segments.text: Return policy sale mein bhi same rahegi na? Customers puchhte hain.

segments.speaker: Ishita Kapoor
segments.text: Haan, same rahegi, koi badlaav nahi.

segments.speaker: Pallavi Ghosh
segments.text: Website pe countdown timer laga dein? Pichhli baar achha response tha.

segments.speaker: Varun Sinha
segments.text: Haan, tech team ko bol denge, chhota kaam hai.

segments.speaker: Ishita Kapoor
segments.text: Okay. Kuch aur?

segments.speaker: Rakesh Yadav
segments.text: पैकिंग के लिए extra लोग चाहिए होंगे sale के हफ़्ते में।

segments.speaker: Ishita Kapoor
segments.text: Woh Rakesh, tum HR se baat karo temporary staff ke liye, sale ke hafte ke liye.

segments.speaker: Rakesh Yadav
segments.text: Theek hai, main HR se baat kar leta hoon.

segments.speaker: Ishita Kapoor
segments.text: Great, thank you sab. Bahut kaam hai, chaliye lag jaate hain.

decisions.fact: The winter sale starts on 4 December and runs for seven days.
The campaign uses only micro influencers, no big names.

action_items.fact: Pallavi finalises and sends all creatives, banners and reels.
The email list is cleaned before the sale; nobody named.
Varun prepares a channel-wise split of the ad budget.
Rakesh speaks to HR about temporary packing staff for sale week.

distractors.fact: A radio jingle on local FM was suggested and dropped.
28 November is the warehouse stock count, not the creatives' due date.
